notes: §1985:VI.5.8.4 GR2 requires "In format 1, the value of integer-2 represents the exact number of occurrences" and "In format 2, the current value of the data item referenced by data-name-1 represents the number of occurrences", with integer-2 the maximum and integer-1 the minimum; the value of data-name-1 "must fall within the range integer-1 through integer-2" and occurrences beyond it "are undefined". ValueInitializer.FieldInit builds every table with integer-2 elements (the fixed count, and the storage of a DEPENDING ON table at its maximum, so the subject's length does not vary), and CobolTable.At maps an occurrence number onto it. The current count is read from data-name-1 at each use (PlaceRenderer.CountRead): ControlFlowEmitter.EmitSearchScan bounds SEARCH and SEARCH ALL by it and CobolTable.OdoExtent sizes a containing group by it. No edition arm separates 85 from 2023 in these members; the 2023 addition, EC-BOUND-ODO for a value outside the range, is raised by CurrentCount and the five-argument At only when that checking is enabled, and otherwise the count is clamped to 0..integer-2, a permitted outcome of what 1985 leaves undefined. The witness runs a fixed table and a 1 TO 5 table at two counts through a group DISPLAY and a serial SEARCH; a probe at --std 85 added a two-dimensional fixed table (12 characters), a 0 TO 5 table at counts 5, 3, 0 and 6 (group lengths 11, 7, 1, 11; serial and binary searches bounded by the count) and a count below integer-1, all without a diagnostic or an abnormal end.

next.reason: 1985: "the value of the data item referenced by data-name-1 must fall within the range integer-1 through integer-2."; 2023: "If the value of the data item does not fall within the specified bounds, the EC-BOUND-ODO exception condition is set to exist.". Fixed count, variable count, minimum/maximum and undefined excess contents all match. 2023 adds a defined effect for an out-of-range DEPENDING value (EC-BOUND-ODO set); 1985 stated none.
